verdict.rationale: Blaxel's first-party docs cover the whole story: exposing specific TCP ports so external clients can reach web or dev servers inside the sandbox [blaxel-docs-23], and rendering a running app through a direct preview URL with optional auth or tokens and custom domains [blaxel-docs-33, blaxel-docs-8, blaxel-docs-3]. Ports and previews are also operable through the sandbox's built-in MCP server [blaxel-docs-38]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that port exposure via public preview URLs works as documented.
